scope: Current retained benchmark and qualification evidence; per-artifact source revisions and commands are authoritative.

benchmarks-2026-09-29.scope: Single-user AR/MTP depth sweeps, loading and memory on both engines; llama.cpp multi-user AR/MTP; third-party Vulkan fork (halo-box/strix-llama.cpp) single-user AR and mixed MTP (UTC dates in artifacts)

gufo.tables: every Gufo table, remeasured 2026-09-29 (sampled MTP at depth 0 only)

benchmarks-2026-09-29.reference: llama.cpp b11069 from flake.nix (commit 68d9053a), ROCm gfx1151; measured 2026-09-26 and not rerun (same pinned build)
benchmarks-2026-09-29.measurement: One warmed sample per point, greedy, thinking off, four MTP draft tokens on both engines. Loading drops the page cache with echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches before each launch.
benchmarks-2026-09-29.images: Gufo image requests remeasured 2026-09-29 with the binary16 vision encoder; llama.cpp rows from 2026-09-28

gufo.tables: UD-Q8_K_XL reduced grid: single-user depths 0/4096/16384/32768, sampled MTP d0, C1-C2, memory, loading

benchmarks-2026-09-30-q8.reference: llama.cpp b11069 from flake.nix, ROCm gfx1151, measured 2026-09-30 on the same grid
benchmarks-2026-09-30-q8.measurement: One warmed sample per point (sampled MTP: three seeds), greedy, thinking off; MTP drafts up to seven (Gufo, calibrated policy) and four (llama.cpp). Loading drops the page cache with sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches before each launch.

gufo.tables: every Gufo table (UD-Q4_K_XL and UD-Q8_K_XL), remeasured 2026-10-07 after the server-path changes (device snapshots, generation prompt in the last prefill forward, tokenizer, shared snapshot blocks)

benchmarks-2026-10-07.reference: llama.cpp columns unchanged (pinned b11069, ROCm gfx1151; dates in BENCHMARKS.md)
benchmarks-2026-10-07.measurement: One warmed sample per point (sampled MTP: three seeds), greedy, thinking off; MTP drafts up to 15 (Gufo, calibrated policy) and four (llama.cpp). Loading drops the page cache with sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches before each launch.
